01 / WHO WE ARE

Science should be understandable.

RE:EARTH is a student-created science communication project focused on climate change and environmental sustainability.

We wanted the website to do more than display paragraphs. Our approach combines clear explanations, visual storytelling, interactive learning and a climate map so visitors can explore the topic for themselves.

02 / OUR PURPOSE

What we are trying to do.

◎

Educate

Make climate concepts easier to understand by breaking complex ideas into clear sections and visual explanations.

↗

Engage

Encourage visitors to interact with quizzes, climate information, a weather map and clickable learning elements.

✦

Inspire action

Connect knowledge with responsible choices and show that environmental sustainability involves everyday decisions.

05 / OUR APPROACH

Click to reveal
what we value.

Good science communication is not only about having information. It is also about how that information is presented and used.

We aim to communicate climate information clearly and avoid presenting dramatic claims without context. Visitors should be able to distinguish explanation, evidence and personal action.
The website is designed around short sections, visual hierarchy, readable typography and interactive elements so that a public audience can explore the topic without needing specialist knowledge.
The project follows the assignment's emphasis on responsible communication, credible references, ethical use of content and a professional user experience.
Visitors can actively explore rather than simply read: the Learn page includes interactive explanations and a quiz, while the Map page allows location-based weather exploration.
